name: Waving flag
blurb: Wind-blown stripes. Stars light up under the pointer.

name: Night map
blurb: A dark map of the US, Europe, or both. Borders and states light up under the pointer, with clouds drifting over.

name: Night camp
blurb: A blurred night yard: barbed wire swaying up front, a flickering lamp, a dim flag, and candles that light in the windows.

name: Old Glory
blurb: An accurate, waving American flag in grayscale. Color comes back around the pointer: a fading trail, a spotlight, or ripples.
